about: Which addresses a drawn page asks for are videos, for do-work/list-the-videos-a-site-plays.mjs. A request is a video when the browser says its type is one of request_types, its path ends in one of extensions, or its whole address matches one of players (a hosted player's stream or file address). A video at a host in strip_query_hosts is kept without its query, since each play signs the same stream with a new one-time query. A new player is one entry here.
